[[Pei the Skull Blade]] is a [[Crimson Skull]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Panjiang Peninsula]].

==Locations==
*[[Shing Jea Island]]
**{{NPC location|Panjiang Peninsula}}

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Blades of Steel}}
*{{skill icon|Golden Lotus Strike}}
*{{skill icon|Golden Phoenix Strike}} 
*{{skill icon|Shroud of Distress}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Bolt of Cloth]]
*[[Bolt of Linen]] 
*[[Crimson Skull Cape]]
*[[Pei's Blades]] ([[unique]])
*[[Ruby]]
*[[Silver Crimson Skull Coin]]

==Notes==
*Removing or interrupting her [[Shroud of Distress]] not only denies her a strong defensive effect but also prevents her from using Golden Phoenix Strike and Blades of Steel.
** She will only use the skill if her health drops below 25%, so you can also try to [[spike]] her before she activates it. [[Unblockable]] attacks (e.g. [[Fox Fangs]] or [[Leviathan's Sweep]]) can help finish her off too.

==Trivia==
*She will repeatedly use the /bored emote while her two subordinates aboard the ship will use /yawn.
